# Evidence
- Problem class: js-linear-scan-register-allocator-spill-split

signatures.description: Implement a linear-scan register allocator for a three-address IR over a control-flow graph with loops: compute live intervals by iterative dataflow (not a single linear pass over blocks), assign 4 general registers, and when pressure exceeds capacity choose the spill candidate by furthest-next-use weighted against spill cost, then split the interval at the spill point (usable intervals), inserting reloads at uses and stores at definitions and at block boundaries that the spilling block does not dominate. Handle the loop case correctly: a value live across a back edge must not be reassigned to the entry-point register of the loop header without a live-range hole, and must emit a redundant load only when the existing value in that register was clobbered along the path. Output allocation as {intervalId, reg, spills:[{at, kind}]} plus the rewritten IR, and include a differential test that interprets both IRs on randomized inputs and asserts identical observable results across 1000 seeds.
